# DiOro999.9

> Gold jewellery and bullion, 925 sterling silver and new watches, sold online in US dollars. Every listing states purity and weight.

DiOro999.9 is a small online shop. Prices are in US dollars and exclude shipping. Bars and coins follow the daily metal price and are confirmed at order. There is no online payment yet: a customer adds pieces to the cart and sends an order request; the shop confirms stock, shipping and the total by email or WhatsApp within one business day; the customer pays by link (card or PayPal) or bank transfer; the shop ships insured and tracked. Returns within 14 days for unworn pieces in the original packaging; sealed bars and coins must stay sealed.

Contact (placeholders until the owner confirms): phone +1 (000) 000-0000, WhatsApp +1 000 000 0000, email orders@example.com, TODO street, TODO city, TODO state 00000, hours Mon to Sat, 10:00 to 19:00.
